section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: The Complex Numbers

title: Divide complex numbers
sources: OpenStax College Algebra 2e §2.4 Example 7 p. 128 (CC BY 4.0): method only (Bittinger 3.1 Example 6 is on the missing notebook p. 72)

let.z: expand((a + b i)(c - d i)/(c^2 + d^2))

steps.name: write the division as a fraction
find the conjugate of the denominator
multiply the fraction by the conjugate over itself
replace i squared with negative one
write the answer as a real part plus an imaginary part

mistakes.name: multiplied only the numerator by the conjugate
mistakes.message: Multiply the numerator AND the denominator by the conjugate (that is multiplying by 1).

hints.step: write the division as a fraction
hints.why: Division by a complex number is done as a fraction.

hints.step: find the conjugate of the denominator
hints.hint: Change the sign of the imaginary part.
hints.why: A number times its conjugate is real.

hints.step: multiply the fraction by the conjugate over itself
replace i squared with negative one
write the answer as a real part plus an imaginary part
hints.why: Answers go in a + bi form.
